PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition. Nothing you say is written to disk.

## New in this release

### Updates keep your settings

Updating used to start from default settings, because each release folder kept its own.

- **Settings are shared.** Settings and custom sounds now live in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrivateType`, so every copy for your Windows user, including the next update, starts with them. A portable copy with an `app\data` folder keeps its own settings, as before.
- **Bring over settings from an earlier copy.** On its first start, PrivateType finds the copy you used most recently and asks once whether to import its settings, before model setup. Everything except Windows startup comes along, including a custom sound file. **Settings → General → Other copies** imports from a folder you choose, for review before saving.
- Settings saved by a newer version are kept when an older copy saves, so switching between versions does not lose them.

### Recent dictations shortcut

- **Settings → Shortcuts** can now change the recent dictations shortcut. Win+Shift+V stays the default. A shortcut needs Win, or two of Ctrl, Alt and Shift; Ctrl+Alt (AltGr) and a dictation shortcut's exact combination are refused.
- Releasing Alt after the shortcut no longer opens the menu bar of the window behind it.

### Parakeet is recommended for new installs

- First-run setup lists Parakeet first, marked Recommended, and says when to choose Nemotron instead. Existing installs keep the model they use, and a new release folder reuses a model already in the shared cache instead of asking for a download.

### Fixes

- Holding the dictation shortcut no longer occasionally ends the dictation after a quarter of a second and starts a new one. When the model had to load, this made "Loading model" play twice.

### Documentation

- A new [settings guide](https://github.com/kkolodziejczak/PrivateType/blob/v1.4.0/docs/SETTINGS.md) explains each setting, its default, and when to change it, with screenshots of every Settings page.
- The README is shorter and lists every keyboard shortcut.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.4.0-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.4.0-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.4.0` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. If you used an earlier version, accept the offer to import its settings. Otherwise, choose a speech model and approve its separate download if it is not already in the shared cache.

Speech models are not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads the one you choose directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use. Models already downloaded by versions 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 are reused.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room; add 0.7 GB to keep both models
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, or retained audio. Recent dictations stay in memory only and can be turned off in Settings. The shared settings file stores preferences and vocabulary, never audio or dictated text. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
